title: Case 041: Payroll file receipt confirmation
initial_request: Please confirm whether my June 2025 payroll file, batch-041.csv, was received. I need to know the file's receipt status; I am not asking the bank to authorise payments on the company's behalf.
overview: Mara Ellison escalated a query about a payroll file uploaded through H&V's business portal. The agent checked the import journal and confirmed that the file was received. No validation, payment authorisation, or payment execution was confirmed.

next_action.summary: Check the import journal for the receipt record for batch-041.csv.

outcome: H&V confirmed receipt of batch-041.csv for the June 2025 payroll, with two listed entries totalling £805.00. Validation, authorisation, and payment execution remain unconfirmed; receipt does not mean the file's rows have been processed.

events.body: I uploaded batch-041.csv for Northmere Studio Ltd.'s June 2025 payroll under reference HV-041. It lists Staff A at £420.00 and Staff B at £385.00; please confirm whether the file was received.

I am the company's authorised file uploader, and I can see that I submitted batch-041.csv, but I cannot tell whether H&V received it. Please check receipt only; I am not asking you to approve or release any payment.
I am checking the import journal for receipt of batch-041.csv under reference HV-041, as my first step in this escalation.
I found an import-journal entry recording receipt of batch-041.csv. The entry confirms receipt only; it does not confirm validation, authorisation, or payment.
Receipt confirmed: batch-041.csv, reference HV-041, June 2025 payroll. This confirms that the file was received only; validation, payment authorisation, and payment execution are not confirmed.
